thread:
sara_csm: Quick FYI — Velora's onboarding account just tripped an embeddings surge alert at 07:12 UTC. Spike looks like a new indexing pipeline. Monthly commit usage is now at ~68% after the burst. Need a fast triage and a short QBR addendum with mitigation steps.

alert-bot: [Alert] embed-usage-spike: velora-prod exceeded baseline by 5.8x at 3359990000. Rule=rolling_4h > 5 * baseline_4h.

lena_pse: Thanks. Can we get their job config (batch size, concurrency, input_size)? If they're doing per-row calls we can usually reduce cost by batching or switching to the bulk embeddings endpoint.

sara_csm: I reached out to their eng lead; they said "we kicked off a nightly backfill; using our existing per-item client logic". Asked for logs + git snippet.

diego_finops: I'll run a short-run forecast and model two scenarios: (1) continue at current rate, (2) pause + resume with batching. Expect results in ~30m. If they continue, projected overspend = ~3.1x vs commit.

harry_enable: I can run a 30-min enablement session to show batching, prefix caching, and our vector upload API. Scheduling outbound now. Also want to collect feedback on their client ergonomics to reduce accidental per-item calls.

analytics-bot: Telemetry summary: 52% of Velora calls are <=64 tokens; median batch_size=1. Recs: batch_size>=20, use combined_inputs, and enable prefix cache for repeat texts.

lena_pse: Example quick sample to show them (one-liner):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-base-1",
  "inputs": ["doc1","doc2",...],
  "batch_size": 32
}
```

diego_finops: Forecast posted: https://drive.redwood/velora-mini-forecast.csv TL;DR: if they pause the backfill and relaunch with batching, estimated monthly embed cost drops from $9.2k -> $3.0k (approx 67% savings). No change = $28k/mo.

sara_csm: Action items: 1) Velora to pause the job (they confirmed) 2) @harry_enable run 30-min enablement + capture config 3) @lena_pse produce a 2-slide playbook for QBR addendum 4) @diego_finops add numbers to the QBR deck and headline 'cost-savings' bullet 5) Create CS ticket and mark as high priority.

alert-bot: [Info] ticket CS-4789 created for velora embed surge triage.

harry_enable: Enablement invite sent for tomorrow 08:30 PT. Will ask them to paste the job config beforehand. Plan: demo batch endpoint, show how to measure tokens per-row, and set a simple throttle rule in their infra.

lena_pse: I'll attach a short health-check script they can run: check for median tokens, average batch size, and call rate. If any field < recommended threshold, alert.

analytics-bot: Filed product feedback: "Make SDKs surface batch convenience helpers + warn on batch_size=1" (roadmap ticket PF-212).

diego_finops: For the QBR addendum: suggested one-liner "Switching to batched embeddings and prefix caching can reduce embed spend by ~60-70% for bulk index jobs." Use with the cost table in the deck.

sara_csm: I'll draft the addendum slide and ping eng-docs to publish the playbook. Closing loop here after enablement — please drop final post-mitigation burn numbers in this thread. :thumbsup:
summary: Velora onboarding triggered an embeddings surge. Team paused job, scheduled enablement, ran forecasts showing ~60-70% savings with batching, and will produce a QBR addendum + playbook.
